scope: Renderer bypass pipeline creation and shipped ioctl ABI; ARM userspace/source boundary only
constraints: No TV access or runtime mutation
No DSP images, exports, tools, extensions, or projects accessed
No shared Ghidra project or production files modified

address_conventions.userspace: Raw ELF virtual address, with Thumb bit cleared for code. Relevant executable LOAD maps raw VA to file offset identically. Existing Ghidra export uses raw + 0x10000; not an ASLR runtime address.
address_conventions.kernel: Addresses are byte offsets from the beginning of the verified decompressed ARM64 Image, also used as offset-space disassembly addresses. No absolute running kernel VA or KASLR slide asserted. COFF objdump may print misleading .text+ labels; use the numeric instruction address.
address_conventions.kernel_symbols: Function identities are reconstructed from exact diagnostic string calculations, ioctl dispatch/call arguments, and comparison with published source; no kernel symbol table or new Ghidra project used.

evidence.observation: PCM getter constructs with rtsPCM=true unless an existing PCM bypass is present; ES getter logs bypass is not yet created then constructs with rtsPCM=false when is_bypass_created is false.
evidence.limitation: Published source is not the exact running kernel build; shipped getter and constructor independently checked in LOCAL-RABI-008 and LOCAL-RABI-009.

evidence.observation: Decompile orders GET_BYPASS_UID 0x80045203 and module connection before ioctl 0x4008522b with aren_msgpid_to_signal_t payload. Independently verified at raw call sites 0x14728, 0x14744, 0x147d4; latter return is not tested.
evidence.limitation: Plugin DWARF import conflicts and unresolved locals exist; not treating pseudocode alone as raw proof.

evidence.observation: lgao_open allocates 0x1f0 bytes and calls KADP_InitSystem at 0x14bf4; fd and index default to -1. _lgao_open_renderer reads index at ao+8, adds 4 if ao+4 isMixer is nonzero, opens /dev/lg/aren0 at 0x14942, stores returned fd at ao+0, sends SET_INDEX 0x40045201 at 0x14956 and SET_PROC_ID 0x40045228 at 0x14976. SET_INDEX return is ignored. All investigated renderer ioctls reload the same ao+0 fd.

Payload is {int msgq_id; int pid;}: DWARF structure DIE 0x186d0 has size 8; member DIEs 0x186d9 and 0x186e6 have offsets 0 and 4. Typedef DIE 0x186f4 is aren_msgpid_to_signal_t, declared at shipped header lines 200-203. Raw code loads callback queue at ao+0x1b0, stores it at sp+0x1c, calls getpid, stores pid at sp+0x20, and passes sp+0x1c to ioctl. Return is discarded; code then installs SIGUSR1 (10) sigaction. _sig_handle converts si_int to a message-queue destination and sends LGAO_EVENT_UNDERFLOW according to existing decompile.

Correct modern renderer ABI header is aud_kapi_renderer.h, magic R. Published request list ends at 42 (SET_VSP_MODE); no request 43 or aren_msgpid_to_signal_t handler. Legacy audio_kapi_renderer.h separately reuses magic R and number 43 for a differently sized FEED_BYPASS structure; it is not the modern aren handler. Modern switch compares full encoded command, not number alone.
evidence.limitation: Source snapshot alone cannot establish shipped handler absence. LOCAL-RABI-007 supplies independent kernel proof.

evidence.observation: Existing orig/boot/Image-5.4.268-329.decompressed is Linux ARM64 Image 5.4.268-329.ptl4tv.5. Original file is LG LZ4P, not a plain LZ4 frame. Already-installed liblz4 decompressed all 140 blocks in memory; every byte and total SHA256 match the pre-existing extraction. Original compressed kernel, sink and kadaptor hashes match re/lg-c2-webos25-audio/SHA256SUMS.
evidence.limitation: Artifact identity is proven; no new observation of the currently booted TV or live fd was made.

evidence.observation: Handler extracts 14-bit ioctl size at 0xc304b0, allows <=0x108, and copies write payload at 0xc30574-0xc30588. For command 0x4008522b, exact comparison path is 0xc304dc -> 0xc30660 -> 0xc3078c -> 0xc3081c -> 0xc3082c -> 0xc308a8 -> default 0xc308e0. Default computes function-name pointer 0x1562000+0xbd0+0x1d0=0x1562da0 (driver_aren_ioctl), message 0x185d000+0x338 (Invalid IOCTL Call!!! %x newline), and sets x20=-25 at 0xc30914. Returns x20 at 0xc30558. Nearby compat wrapper 0xc30cf0 directly calls 0xc30494, without remapping. The 8-byte payload is not rejected for size.

GET_BYPASS_UID comparison at 0xc307a0-0xc307ac selects 0xc30a24, sets bypass=true and calls aren_get_uid at 0xc35ab0 through 0xc3080c. aren_get_uid reads stored pcm_bypass and pcm_multi_ch at per-renderer offsets 0x48 and 0x4c (PCM-info base 0x30). If either is nonzero, it calls PCM getter 0xc251d0; otherwise ES getter 0xc25340. ES getter tests renderer+0x4c is_bypass_created, logs exact notice when false, then 0xc25390 sets w1=0 and 0xc25394 calls constructor 0xc21894, before returning pipeline head at 0xc2539c. PCM getter tests created and mode at renderer+0x4c/+0x4d, calls same constructor with w1=1 if needed, and returns uid_rts_bypass. SET_PCM_INFO handler 0xc37b40 copies all 32 payload bytes to stored per-renderer PCM info; it does not construct a pipeline.

Constructor obtains preferred processor, deletes previous pipeline if nonnull, creates named renderer_bypass. False mode appends queue (string 0x171c140); true mode appends rts (0x189a458), srcbin (0x185a978), registers rts and sets defaults. Both append lipsync (0x185a980), register it and set defaults, forward input and output port 0x100 to pipeline port 0, store mode at renderer+0x4d (0xc21980) and created=true at renderer+0x4c (0xc21988). Pipeline name string at 0x185a968. Names and structure agree with source. No claim about execution inside those processing modules.

Uppercase BYPASS literal raw 0x1b388 is read as int at 0x88f6; nonzero branch calls lgao_set_drop_renderer(ao,1) at 0x8952 then exits caps handling. Presence of integer DUMMY (literal 0x1b404; read at 0x89aa) exits caps handling even without checking the returned field value. Lowercase es (raw 0x1bd14 / Ghidra 0x2bd14) is read as boolean at 0x97ba and, if present, saved in AudioInfo at sp+0xf8. No absent-es default is asserted. lgao_set_audio_info only copies info.es to ao+0x5c at 0x167b2; no ioctl or constructor there. Caps creation path requires a nonnegative lgao_get_port result (0xa98e-0xa992) and drop_renderer==0 (0xa8e2-0xa8f0), then calls open_renderer at 0xb614, set_audio_info at 0xb668, config at 0xb6aa, connect_renderer at 0xb6ec. Changed/same caps branches also exist; these sites are not claimed to describe every event branch.
evidence.limitation: Existing full gst_lg_audio_render_event decompile failed with Duplicate VariablePiece. Relevant gates and call sites were instead read from raw instructions; not a complete event reconstruction.

evidence.observation: pcm-bypass and pcm-multi-ch setters only save normalized bytes at ao+0x1d0/+0x1d1; defaults are false. Properties set before ao exists are replayed through preopen_conditions after lgao_open in change_state. lgao_config, unless state==2 (already PLAY), calls _lgao_config_set_renderer_param: serializes 8 uint32 fields and sends 0x40205220 before connect. Payload offsets are rate 0, channels 4, bits 8, byte_align 12, sign 16, clock_x4 20, pcm_bypass 24, pcm_multi_ch 28. No es member. lgao_push_first_event branches on combined two mode bytes: both zero creates bypass event with es=true, codec string and data fields; either nonzero creates PCM bypass event instead. Events are pushed on already-connected appsrcs, not used to allocate the head.

Published device open allocates per-fd metadata, not a selected renderer. Shipped SET_INDEX calls aren_open at 0xc30b18 and stores requested index at private_data+0x10 at 0xc30b24 even if aren_open fails. Shipped aren_open 0xc355c4 bounds-checks index 0..9, rejects already-open entries, calls bm_create_block(renderer,index) at 0xc35634, stores pointer and open flag. Source explains zero-allocation and constructor dispatch; renderer_create initializes is_bypass_created=false and main pipeline, not bypass. Sink index is caller-supplied: index property or resource-info audio-port/mixer-port -> lgao_set_port -> ao.index -> SET_INDEX. lgao_set_port accepts audio port 0/1, or audioPort=-1 and mixerPort 0..6, latter also sets mixer mode; open adds 4 for mixer. No kernel automatic free-index ioctl or renderer pointer returned to caller; caller receives module UIDs via GET_UID/GET_BYPASS_UID/GET_TAIL_UID. No resource-booking service was analyzed.

KADP_InitSystem is invoked by lgao_open, performs global init guarded by semaphore/refcount and iterates an initializer table. Raw Thumb loop at 0x61bce-0x61bd6 is indirect. Actual renderer open/ioctl/aimc connection sequence is compiled inside libgstlgaudiosink, not delegated to a KADP renderer wrapper. Existing exported kadaptor function inventory has no renderer API and exact aren0/0x4008522b searches in its decompile found no occurrences.
evidence.limitation: Negative inventory/search results do not prove the entire kadaptor initializer table cannot affect generic device setup; it is not needed to establish ownership of the observed direct ioctls.

evidence.observation: lgadec_set_es_bypass changes decoder-side flag at adec+0x368 before decoder initialization, or writes a command through its pipe under a mutex after initialization (flag +0x369). It is not a renderer-head allocation call. Decoder dummy caps set integer DUMMY and BYPASS from lgadec_get_es_bypass in existing _gst_lg_adec_set_caps_srcpad_dummy pseudocode. Sink DUMMY/BYPASS handling is independently raw-verified.

Independent source creation trigger: renderer_preconnect with port==BYPASS_PORT (0x100) and pipeline_bypass==NULL calls renderer_create_bypass_pipeline(false). Shipped raw instructions at 0xc21a0c, 0xc21a98, 0xc21ad0 have the matching gate and constructor call. Source main-pipeline recreation also rebuilds bypass when is_bypass_created was already true (renderer.c 1449-1451).
evidence.limitation: No analysis of downstream connection policy or module runtime performed.

creation_sequence.call: gst_lg_audio_render_change_state -> lgao_open -> KADP_InitSystem; replay preopen properties
Caller index/resource-info -> lgao_set_port -> ao.index; caps path validates/reuses index and drop_renderer
lgao_open_renderer -> _lgao_open_renderer -> open(/dev/lg/aren0) -> SET_INDEX(index + (isMixer ? 4 : 0)) -> aren_open -> bm_create_block(renderer,index); aimc init and SET_PROC_ID
lgao_set_audio_info -> lgao_config -> _lgao_config_set_renderer_param -> SET_PCM_INFO(0x40205220); copies PCM mode flags only, no bypass construction

lgao_connect_renderer -> _lgao_connect_renderer -> create appsrc and bypass_appsrc -> sync registry -> ADD_QUEUE(0x5221) -> GET_UID(0x80045202) -> GET_TAIL_UID(0x80045222) -> connect main appsrc -> create appsink -> connect renderer tail port1 to appsink

GET_BYPASS_UID(0x80045203) -> driver_aren_ioctl -> aren_get_uid(index,true) -> (pcm_bypass || pcm_multi_ch ? PCM getter : ES getter) -> lazy renderer_create_bypass_pipeline(true/false) -> return head UID

aimc_module_connect(bypass_appsrc,0,headUID,0); if success send SET_BYPASS_FADER(0x40015224), SET_QUEUE_MAX_LENGTH(0x40045227), notification ioctl(0x4008522b,{msgq_id,pid}); ignore notification return; install SIGUSR1 handler
Later first-event emission uses existing appsrc objects; both PCM flags false builds es=true event. This event does not construct the bypass head.

gate_table.effect: Set drop_renderer=1 and exit caps handling; not ES-head creation
Exit caps handling after successful get_int; raw path does not require value==1
When present, metadata copied to ao+0x5c; not a SET_PCM_INFO field and not constructor trigger; absent-field default not asserted

gate_table.gate: pcm-bypass=0 and pcm-multi-ch=0 at driver GET_BYPASS_UID
gate_table.effect: ES getter; new pipeline is queue -> lipsync

gate_table.gate: pcm-bypass!=0 or pcm-multi-ch!=0 at driver GET_BYPASS_UID
gate_table.effect: PCM getter; new/rebuilt pipeline is rts -> srcbin -> lipsync
Reuse pipeline head, even if existing mode is PCM; no mode check in this getter

gate_table.gate: PCM getter with created=true and is_bypass_rts_PCM=true
gate_table.effect: Reuse RTS head; otherwise reconstruct as PCM

gate_table.gate: Negative index or drop_renderer!=0 in relevant caps creation path
gate_table.effect: Does not take fresh open/config/connect branch; index -1 rejected by lgao_open_renderer
Skip parameter serialization; setting a PCM property alone does not immediately update kernel mode

ioctl.purpose: Message-queue/PID notification registration, inferred semantic role from shipped name/layout and following SIGUSR1 setup; not a bypass constructor command
ioctl.classification: Missing/unsupported notification ABI command in the captured shipped renderer handler; proven userspace/kernel ABI mismatch for this command
ioctl.wrong_fd: Not supported as an explanation for this compiled path: same fd opened from /dev/lg/aren0, configured with renderer index, used for accepted renderer ioctls. Historical live fd provenance was not traced.
ioctl.stale_published_source: Published source is not exact running build, but this result is not based on source absence alone: shipped kernel dispatch independently rejects it. Source and captured kernel agree on lack of this command.
ioctl.compat: Shipped compat wrapper directly forwards same command, no alternate encoding

claims.claim: The logged not-yet-created message is immediately followed by lazy ES pipeline construction in the captured shipped kernel; it is not evidence of failed creation.
Request 0x4008522b is rejected by the shipped renderer dispatch with ENOTTY; userspace sends it after successful bypass appsrc connection and ignores its result.

The two historical diagnostics need not share a failure cause: one is a normal lazy-construction log, the other a missing notification ABI. The latter cannot be the constructor command responsible for the former.

Simply setting es=true is insufficient proof of head existence or correct mode. The driver GET_BYPASS_UID and stored PCM flags determine construction, and ES getter reuses any existing bypass pipeline.
The historical trial's returned head UID, syscall return values, actual live fd target, successful module construction, and audibility cannot be established from the two quoted log messages.

next_runtime_experiment.description: Observer-only trace of one already-authorized existing playback startup; do not inject ioctls, change caps/properties, reserve resources, or start another renderer. Capture openat/close/ioctl return values and fd paths (e.g. existing strace -f -yy -e trace=openat,close,ioctl if already available), correlate existing sink head-UID/connection logs. Do not guess a free renderer index.
minimum_observations: Same fd opens /dev/lg/aren0; SET_INDEX(0x40045201) returns 0 and record supplied index
SET_PCM_INFO(0x40205220) precedes GET_BYPASS_UID; decode eight words only with an already-authorized observer
GET_BYPASS_UID(0x80045203) returns 0 and nonzero head UID
Existing bypass appsrc connection log succeeds before notification call
0x4008522b returns -1 ENOTTY on same fd while preceding head request succeeded
next_runtime_experiment.discriminates: Separates index ownership/open failure or head creation failure from the already-proven missing notification command. No DSP, module load, kernel patch, or policy changes needed.
